account: Etcera is a product of Akimilabs in Canada. On 15 April 2025 the company opened a waitlist for an invite-only beta of Etcera Space. In an International Telecommunication Union (ITU) report that is current as of June 2025, the makers describe an internal minimum viable product (MVP) of a multi-agent assistant that is intended to reduce decision fatigue and cognitive overload. They report that they were testing it with selected knowledge professionals in product, development, operations and creative roles. They report no productivity or well-being outcome. The company reports that the use case was selected as one of 37 winners at the AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva in July 2025. In October 2026 Etcera Space remains in invite-only early access, and the makers have published no measured outcomes. The current product description centers on personal intentions and choices. The 2025 account centered on the productivity of knowledge workers.
